critique.critique_summary: Scientifically comprehensive but not publication-ready. The matched timelines, independent candidate sets, synchronized correction, lane-local feedback, and separate evaluation are well represented. However, the lower band has an actual text collision and clipped content, and most labels fall below the requested print size. The sole explicit placeholder satisfies both labeling requirements; its high score does not imply that the overall layout is polished.
specific_issues: The Adaptation text 'persistent edits.' overlaps the protocol note at the bottom. Its baseline is at approximately y=683 on a 686-unit canvas, leaving descenders clipped.

At the specified 160 mm width, 20-unit text becomes approximately 6.3 pt, 22-unit text approximately 6.9 pt, and the placeholder description approximately 5 pt. Most labels therefore fail the requested 8–10 pt readability target.
The shared-setup branch arrowheads are obscured by lane backgrounds drawn afterward. The branching structure is suggested by a bracket rather than clearly terminating at both initial states.
The evaluation band is vertically underallocated: its heading, explanatory text, human-audit placeholder, three measurement groups, and disclaimer compete for insufficient space.
The footer runs almost against the bottom canvas boundary, with no adequate safety margin for export or publication placement.

The scheduled-instruction delivery and baseline feedback transition occupy the same narrow round-2 corridor and converge near the same state entry, weakening the visual distinction between exogenous instructions and behavioral feedback.
The incoming feedback arrow originates beneath the second displayed document rather than a slate-level connector, which can suggest feedback on that item alone.
The Adaptation measurement is present in the SVG but not fully readable in the rendered figure, compromising delivery of a required measurement component.
improvement_suggestions: Rebuild the layout around a minimum text size of approximately 25.4 SVG units for 8 pt at 160 mm; shorten repeated wording instead of shrinking labels.
Reserve a separate footer row with sufficient bottom padding, and shorten Adaptation to 'Exposures after correction; inappropriate persistent edits.'
Reduce introductory prose and redundant legend text to free space for the evaluation band while preserving the approximately 2.1:1 canvas.
Draw shared-setup branch connectors after the lane backgrounds and terminate them visibly at the first state in each lane.
Separate dashed instruction delivery from feedback routing with distinct entry positions and more horizontal clearance.
Connect feedback to the displayed slate as a group rather than visually attaching it only to the second document.
Retain the Human audit exterior label and interior [icon] description during placeholder review; replace the gray production placeholder with a restrained line icon for the final publication.
Validate the exported figure at its actual 160 mm print width, checking text bounds, clipping, connector visibility, and all footer clearances.
